featured_reviews.name: Karyn
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been working out with Studio Burrn by Shefale S, for almost a year. It has been a great experience here for me. If you are new to fitness or already into fitness, there is a journey of growth in your health routine.
The great selling points are:
1. Combination Programs of a variety of exercises from strength training, tabata, spin bike, HIIT, Cross FIT to name a few among many more. They are structured in a group format.
2. Floor trainers to walk you through the routine (esp. If you are a beginner ) and also encouraging you to increase your difficulty level ( if your are in intermediate or advance).
3. The flexibility of timing is a big win where once you clock in you join in the routine and complete the full session in an hr.
4. If you do happen to take a break, you can adjust your tempo to beginner level by doing the work out at an intensity that suits you as it's meant for all levels of fitness . This helps you to bring your momentum back where you don't feel an over load of starting off with something intense.
5. Women in Perimenopause (35 to 40 years +)would find it very beneficial as it has weights and strength training which is so crucial for that phase.
6. It's better than paying for a gym membership and having to figure out what routine of training you want to do when Studio Burrn does that for you and with the trainer on floor guiding you through it in a group.
Surely give Studio Burrn a try. I highly recommend it.
Thank you Shefale for such a practicle format. Best wishes
From,
A Lover of fitness for around 20 years and been into it actively post COVID.

featured_reviews.name: Amey vadhavkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been going to Bombay high for the past 4 months, and it's been a great experience. The equipment is modern and well-maintained, the trainers are friendly and professional, and the crowd is respectful. The gym stays clean and apart from few days as exception never feels overcrowded. I enjoy the weekend yoga  sessions. Highly recommended for beginners and experienced fitness enthusiasts alike.

**Feedback/Suggestions for Improvement:**

- There should be more sessions available, and the session timetable needs to be clearer. It would be helpful if it were regularly published on a screen or notice board for members to see.
- Introducing more group sessions (like HIIT, functional training, etc.) would help engage more trainers and members. This would be especially beneficial for those who do not have a personal trainer, as it would introduce them to new forms of training.
- The BMI machine in the gym could be improved. It doesn't have a history feature or the ability to provide a soft copy of results. Having the option to receive PDF reports for historical reference would be great—as even many basic gyms offer these features.
- Lastly, a positive mention: the cleaning staff does an excellent job keeping the facility clean and hygienic.

Overall, I look forward to seeing these improvements in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had an amazing experience at this gym over the past 3 months. I’ve lost almost 15 kg and feel much fitter, stronger, and more confident now.

featured_reviews.name: Deepa
featured_reviews.review_text: Definitely the best gym in the area!! It has all the best Equipments, motivating environment and super friendly & helpful staff. A huge shoutout to my trainer Rupesh Sir, who is incredibly patient, knowledgeable, extremely professional, passionate about his work, Know how to push me to my limits without being overwhelming & explains the "WHY" behind every exercise, which I really appreciate. featured_reviews.name: Parvati Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training with Sunita Ma’am at The One Fitness Gym, and my experience has been amazing. She’s extremely knowledgeable and focuses on building strength gradually instead of pushing heavy weights right from the start. Her approach makes the workouts feel safe, effective, and sustainable.
What I appreciate most is her well-structured fitness regime. Her functional training sessions are organised into clear levels, which really helps create a sense of progress and challenge. Every workout feels purposeful, and I’ve noticed consistent improvement in my strength and stamina. Highly recommend training with Sunita Ma’am if you’re looking for a dedicated and supportive fitness trainer!

featured_reviews.name: aditi ganguly
featured_reviews.review_text:
My trainer, Sagar Sir, has truly been a blessing. I had been trying to lose weight in a healthy and sustainable way for quite some time, but nothing seemed to work until I started training with him. He is extremely knowledgeable about all aspects of fitness and weight loss and provides thoughtful, thorough guidance tailored to my needs. He ensures that I not only work towards my goals but also feel fit, confident, and healthy throughout the process.

The gym itself is well-equipped, and the staff are warm, supportive, and welcoming. Overall, it has been a very positive and motivating experience.

featured_reviews.name: B U
featured_reviews.review_text:
The One Fitness Club feels more like a sales-driven setup than a fitness-focused space. There’s constant emphasis on payments, renewals, and upgrades, which gets frustrating over time.

The service doesn’t match the pricing. There’s very little effort to engage with members or address concerns meaningfully. Once the membership is sold, the experience becomes quite average.

Overall, not a great value for money. I expected a lot better.
